description: Search the Vimeo video library through the Vimeo API (api.vimeo.com/videos) with a free-text query, plus page, per_page, sort, direction, and filter parameters, authenticated with a Vimeo access token. Returns matching Vimeo videos with title, description, duration, link and embed URLs, owner, and play statistics. Answers which videos hosted on Vimeo match a subject, title, or creator name.
name: videos_search
